property_summary: After a call to transferOwnership(newOwner), the owner is newOwner on success; on revert, the call must have failed because the caller was not the owner, which for this test can only happen if the test is not the owner, but since the test deploys c it is the initial owner, so any successful call changes owner, and any failed call is not possible for the deployer.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: the value of state variable `owner` after a call to `transferOwnership(...)` completes
